original_forecast.resolution_rule: Resolve against the U.S. 10-year Treasury constant-maturity yield for 2026-09-08 or nearest prior published trading day.
rationale: Weak labor data creates easing pressure.
Inflation/geopolitical risk remains large enough to prevent a narrow forecast.
Cross-asset confirmation is more informative than SPX alone.
surprising_if: Outcome falls outside the stated 80% interval or materially contradicts the linked causal story.

resolution.source: U.S. Department of the Treasury, Daily Treasury Par Yield Curve Rates for 2026-09-08.
resolution.audit_note: Original forecast content is preserved without hindsight alteration. The official 4.80% outcome remained inside the frozen 4.30%-4.95% 80% interval. The 4.62% point missed by 18 bp versus 16 bp for frozen no-change, so this record supplies no point-forecast skill versus that benchmark. No probability was assigned, so no Brier or log score is manufactured.
